description: Find Seattle-area games, concerts and shows on given dates (from Seatac's daily Ticketmaster snapshot), the same list seatac.co shows as "Happening while you're here". With near (the airport, a cruise pier, or a hotel area) events are nearest first, one per venue, within 20 miles, with the straight-line distance; without it, the biggest events first. Each event has its start time, the planned ride (pickup time to arrive 45 minutes early, estimated end, ride back), a prefilled round-trip booking link, the event page and the ticket link.

near.description: Where the traveler is: sea-airport, a cruise pier, or a hotel area. Omit for the biggest events.

ride_from.description: Optional address the ride to the event starts from (e.g. their hotel), prefilled in the booking link.

to.description: Last date, inclusive (up to 14 days after from). Omit for one day.

name: find_events_near
title: Find Seattle events near a place
